Each quarter of the test image of the figure, 80 x 80, on its own, with 8 points at radius 1. The default method has 256 codes. The uniform method has the labels 0 to 8 by the number of 1s, and label 9 for all codes that are not uniform. The share is that of the pixels of the quarter.
